invites_used.name: invites_used
invites_used.value: "invites"."used_by" is null or "invites"."used_at" is not null

oauth_tokens_code_fields.name: oauth_tokens_code_fields
oauth_tokens_code_fields.value: ("oauth_tokens"."kind" = 'code') = ("oauth_tokens"."code_challenge" is not null and "oauth_tokens"."redirect_uri" is not null)

stores_niche_text.name: stores_niche_text
stores_niche_text.value: ("stores"."niche" = 'custom') = ("stores"."niche_text" is not null) and ("stores"."niche_text" is null or char_length("stores"."niche_text") between 1 and 60)

upstreams_auth_header.name: upstreams_auth_header
upstreams_auth_header.value:
("upstreams"."auth_type" = 'header') = ("upstreams"."auth_header" is not null)
          and ("upstreams"."auth_header" is null or "upstreams"."auth_header" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$')
